note: Spacious grassy family campground between Grand Rapids and Holland with its own small lake (sandy beach, swimming with no lifeguard, catch-and-release fishing). 'Upfront' sites have electric and water; 'out back' sites have no water. Mix of seasonal campers and nightly stays. The owners' Gospel Music Barn next door holds Sunday services. 23-ft fits. --Claude
summary: Operator's Google Sites page is current (2026 activities; chapelinthepinesfamilycampground.com redirects to it); phone 616-875-8928 matches the site and Google Maps (4.6 / 115 reviews). Confirmed water at the upfront sites and phone reservations; added wifi, laundry, pump-out service (no dump station named), check-in/out. Cleared the derived site count of 100 (not stated by the operator; the note's own breakdown sums to 126). No rate posted ('Please call ... for rates'), so fees stay empty; amperage, sewer, season and max length not stated. Note cleaned: dropped the unsourced ~$44 price, 'reservations by phone' (booking holds it), the inconsistent site breakdown and the Google Sites remark.
flags: No posted nightly rate: the operator's Rates page says only 'Please call 616-875-8928 for rates' (read 2026-10-22); the only price indicator is RV Life's $$ tier. Presence passes (working site + phone; Google Maps 4.6 / 115 reviews, same phone). Nearest gateway Grand Rapids metro 24 km, so the US$50 gate would not bite; the family has not stayed here.

Seasonal share not stated: the rules mention seasonal campers ('No tents for seasonal campers') beside nightly campers, but no page says how many sites are seasonal. If the park proves mostly seasonal, it would fail long-stay test 2 (no posted nightly rate, no booking engine).
